newsitem.title: ESTONIA: KABUAMAJA GETS OK FOR SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: KABUAMAJA GETS OK FOR SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: Tallinna Kaubamaja, one of the largest department stores in Tallinn, said on Monday that its shareholder meeting approved a proposal to organise a bonus share issue of 3.4 million kroons of shares on May 22.
The meeting, held on April 19, confirmed a proposal to carry out the bonus issue of 3,394,100 10-kroon shares, the company said in a statement.
The share issue will double the company's equity to 67.8 million kroons.
The shareholder meeting also confirmed the company's results for 1996 and decided to transfer five percent or 1.4 million kroons of 1996's profit to the company's reserves.
The department store's net profit was 28.8 million kroons, the statement added.
The meeting also chose Andres Eesmaa, Toomas Luman, Meelis Milder and Indrek Neivelt as members of the board.
